Capture a display, window, or region at 720p or 1080p. Auto-selected hardware encoding helps keep recording out of your way.

  • Up to 60 frames per second
  • Mic and system audio
  • Native-resolution capture

Find the moment.

Split long sessions into parts and drop markers as you record. The timeline remembers the moments worth revisiting.

INSIDE THE APP

Every signal. One view.

The real Quhavren 0.1.0-beta.1 interface keeps your preview, sources, audio and performance readings visible without burying the controls.

Quhavren — 0.1.0-beta.1

REAL BETA INTERFACE · 0.1.0-beta.1
CAPTURE TOOLKIT

Built for the whole session.

Not just a record button. Twelve focused tools handle the details before, during and after capture.

Flexible capture

Record a full display, one window, or a selected region.

720p / 1080p

Choose practical HD or sharp Full HD, including native resolution.

Up to 60 FPS

Capture fluid motion for gameplay, walkthroughs, and tutorials.

Hardware encoding

Auto-recommended encoding uses available hardware to keep capture efficient.

Audio mixer

See and control microphone and system audio as separate sources.

Pause & resume

Take a break without ending the recording or starting another file.

Recording parts

Break long sessions into manageable parts while preserving the flow.

Markers

Drop a marker while recording so key moments are easier to find later.

Screenshots

Grab a still frame instantly without interrupting the recording.

Voice commands

Control supported recording actions without reaching for the mouse.

Live performance

Keep FPS, CPU, GPU and RAM readings visible while you work.

Crash recovery

Protection for recordings when a session does not end cleanly.

PERFORMANCE

FAQ

The essentials.

A lightweight Windows screen recorder built around a simple idea: record, speak, organize, and edit without unnecessary overhead.

Creators, students, gamers, educators, and anyone who wants a focused recording workflow—especially on a PC where efficiency matters.

Yes. The first public beta is free and is built for Windows.

You can record a full screen, a selected window, or a region, at 720p or 1080p and up to 60 FPS.

Quhavren is designed with lighter systems in mind. Hardware encoding and a dedicated Low-End Mode help reduce recording overhead, though results still depend on the PC and capture settings.

Parts split a long recording into manageable sections. Markers flag moments on the timeline while you record so they are easier to revisit.

Voice control can trigger supported recording actions. The app shows when voice commands are enabled and when the listener is idle.

Use the copy button above to prepare a structured report with the app version, steps, expected result, actual result, and your system details.
